one_line: A series title and credential in the first second, one simple home activity from above, a smile at the end.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wooden table with a pink and a blue sheet and no object; pink text types in: "יום 1/10", "משחקי התפתחות בבית", "מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק | חלק 3". 0:01 a hand stands four dot markers up. No speech.
q1_hook.why: A numbered series and a credential in the first card promise a bundle of ideas from a trusted source (T3, H2), and the bright markers arrive at 1 s (S1). The first frame is an empty table, the markers cover the text at 0:01-0:02, and there is no voice (against H1, T4, H4).

beats.what: Title text types in; four dot markers are stood up one by one
A hand draws a winding path on blue paper; scissors cut pink paper
beats.why: Shows the activity is made from items at home

beats.what: Numbers written and dots stamped on pink cards
beats.why: Quick preparation steps, each one a new picture

beats.what: A girl at a small table, a card in hand, then hands raised; path on the table
beats.why: The child's arrival adds life to a hands-only start

beats.what: Top-down, side and close views: she stamps dots along the path and checks cards
beats.why: Shows the game and the concentration

beats.what: An adult finger points at a card with orange dots; top-down finished path
beats.why: Checks the count, then shows the result

beats.what: The girl smiles at the camera behind the finished path

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: a save ask, "שמרו לפעם הבאה שמתחשק לכם משחק קטן וצבעוני בבית", and the promise of 10 days of games. No question or send prompt.
q2_flow.why: Quick setup shots give a fast start (E2, R3), the child at 0:09 is the turn and the smile at 0:20 the payoff close to the end (K2, R4). Nine seconds pass before the child appears (K8, R1). The save ask fits a how-to worth returning to (R7).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, near the end: "שמרו לפעם הבאה שמתחשק לכם משחק קטן וצבעוני בבית 💛". Earlier it promises "ב-10 הימים הקרובים אראה לכם...".
q3_cta.why: One ask, to save, with a clear reason, and it suits a useful how-to (C1, R7). It is only in the caption and never said or shown after the demo (against C6). The 10-day promise gives a reason to follow but is not an ask.

q4_shown.what: Four dot markers (Hebrew packaging "טוש נקודות") 0:01-0:03; hands drawing the path and making cards 0:03-0:08; a girl about 4 to 5 stamping dots and counting 0:09-0:19; the finished path and a smile 0:19-0:20. No price; benefits only in the caption.
q4_shown.why: The markers are on screen and used from 1 s (S1), and a child doing the activity plus a finished path is clear proof it works (K8). The developmental claims sit only in the caption (K4). The child's face shows, with no name or place on screen (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 15 shots in 20.6 s (about 1.4 s each), straight cuts, shots that look static, top-down and side views. Text typed in 0:00-0:02 only; no subtitles or speech. Ends on a smile to camera with no end card.
q5_edit.why: Short shots in the setup and closer views in the play keep it moving (E2, R3, F8). The pictures do all the explaining, which works muted but leaves the rules of the game to guesswork (E4, T1). It stops on the payoff with no tail (E8, R4).

q6_topic.what: A 10-day series of quick home games; day 1 is a coloured dot path that practises counting and fine motor skills. It serves parents of preschoolers who want cheap activities.
q6_topic.why: A ready-to-do activity from a named professional answers a real parent need (K6, K4). The benefit bullets are specific, but "ערך התפתחותי ענק" is a big promise (K4). The series format gives a reason to follow, and the calm tone peaks only at the final smile (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A fixed front shot of the table with the markers; static side-on hands shots; a girl at a small table from the side, front, top-down and in close-up; an adult finger once. Bright indoor home light; phone apparently propped.
q7_filmed.why: A steady propped phone and top-down views give clean pictures of hands and the path (F5, F7). Home light and a child at ease look native (H8). The close-up at 0:14 puts her concentration at the centre (K8). The empty first frame has no product (S1).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:02 pink text, centred about 17 to 40 percent down, typed in: "יום 1/10", "משחקי התפתחות בבית", "מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק | חלק 3"; the markers overlap it at 0:01-0:02. No other text: no labels, subtitles or ask.
q8_text.caption: "יום 1/10: מסלול נקודות צבעוני 🎨". About 127 words: series intro, what to do today, four benefit bullets, a substitute tip, a save ask, 5 hashtags (#הורות #ריפויבעיסוק #kid #פעילותלילדים #ילדים). No question, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The first card tells a parent who is speaking and what they get (T3), but "חלק 3" contradicts "יום 1/10", it is up about 3 s for 50 characters (T5), and nothing explains the game once it starts (T1, T2). The caption opens with the day and game and uses searchable terms (T7).

weak_points: The title contradicts itself ("חלק 3" and "יום 1/10"); the first frame is an empty table; no voice or on-screen steps, so the rules are unclear; benefits only in the caption; a child's face on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a numbered series title in the first second, then top-down hands doing one simple activity with the book. Put the tip to save in the caption.
not_verified: Speech or music: the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech; music cannot be told. The marker brand (Hebrew packaging reads "טוש נקודות"). Why the title says "חלק 3". The child's relation to the creator. Correction: at 0:00 only the table and papers show; the first marker appears at 0:01.
